name: A Donation of Wool
summary: The High Order is taking wool cloth from those who seek its full recognition. Sixty pieces meet its current need.

sections.title: A Worthy Gift
sections.body: The High Order is accepting wool cloth, and sixty pieces meet its current needs. The giver can take your donation now. In return, the order grants you full recognition.

faq.q: What does the High Order need?
faq.answer: The High Order needs wool cloth, and sixty pieces meet its current need.

faq.q: How much wool cloth should I give?
faq.answer: Give sixty pieces of wool cloth to earn full recognition from the High Order.
The giver can accept your sixty pieces of wool cloth.

faq.q: What do I gain by donating?
faq.answer: Giving sixty pieces of wool cloth earns you full recognition from the High Order.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Donation of Wool
